title: 第016章 破境二层凝音律，瘴林伏现毒煞鬼
content_zh:
王磊闻言，立刻扶着她走到一旁干净的青石上坐下，警惕地扫视四周，沉声道：“你先在这里调息恢复，我守着，绝对不会让任何人打扰你。”

    梦奇也蹦到青石上，蹲在蔡文姬身边，小鼻子不停嗅着四周：“我也帮文姬守着！有坏人我就吞噬他的神魂噩梦！”

    蔡文姬微微颔首，闭上眼睛盘膝打坐。

    接连破除伏击、惩戒散修、收服梦奇，海量的功德之力依旧在缓缓涌入体内，滋养着她的胡笳仙骨。

    就在灵气缓慢恢复的过程中，那层积压许久的境界壁垒，终于应声而破！

    嗡——

    温和的音律灵气在体内循环流转，经脉被进一步拓宽、淬炼。

    她的修为，正式突破至炼气二层！

    只是这一次突破，并没有想象中那般轻松。

    透支的功德让灵气运转略显滞涩，周身的灵光也只是一闪而逝，并未出现磅礴浩荡的异象。

    【胡笳乐】的连锁弹射上限从六人提升至七人。

    【思无邪】的治愈与净化范围扩大了半倍。

    技能强度虽有提升，却远没有之前那般跨越式的增长。

    “哇！文姬升级了！”梦奇蹦蹦跳跳地欢呼，“以后能打更多坏人了！”

    片刻后，蔡文姬缓缓睁开双眼，脸色依旧带着淡淡的苍白。

    “蔡师妹，你突破了？！”

    王磊感受到她身上骤然变化的灵气波动，又惊又喜，随即又皱起眉头，“可是你看起来状态不太好……”

    “无妨，只是突破时功德略有透支，休息片刻便好。”

    蔡文姬站起身，活动了一下手脚，“此地不宜久留，我们尽快赶往清溪村，免得夜长梦多。”

    王磊见她坚持，也不再多言，只是更加警惕地走在外侧，将她牢牢护在身后。

    梦奇重新窝回蔡文姬的肩头，小声说道：“文姬文姬，要是累了就告诉我，我还有好多好多香香滴梦元呢！”

    “好的，谢谢啦，小团子。”

    随后两人一兽继续前行，山路渐渐变得狭窄。

    又往前走了约莫两里地，王磊忽然停下脚步，眉头紧锁，抬手按住佩剑沉声道：
content_en:
When Wang Lei heard this, he immediately helped her sit down on the clean bluestone aside, scanned the surroundings vigilantly, and said in a deep voice: "You can adjust your breath here first and recover. I will guard her. I will never let anyone disturb you."

    Meng Qi also jumped on the bluestone and squatted next to Cai Wenji. His little nose kept sniffing around: "I will also help Wenji guard! If there is a bad person, I will devour his soul and nightmare!"

    Cai Wenji nodded slightly, closed her eyes and sat cross-legged in meditation.

    After successively breaking off ambushes, punishing casual cultivators, and subduing Mengqi, a large amount of merit power was still slowly pouring into her body, nourishing her Hujia Immortal Bones.

    In the process of the slow recovery of spiritual energy, the long-standing realm barrier was finally broken!

    Buzz——

    The gentle rhythmic spiritual energy circulates in the body, and the meridians are further broadened and tempered.

    Her cultivation level has officially broken through to the second level of Qi Refining!

    But this time, the breakthrough was not as easy as imagined.

    The overdraft of merit made the spiritual energy flow slightly stagnant, and the spiritual light around him only flickered away, without any majestic vision.

    [Hu Jia Le]’s chain ejection limit has been increased from six to seven people.

    The healing and purification range of [Si Wuxie] has been expanded by half.

    Although the skill intensity has been improved, it is far from the leap-forward growth it had before.

    "Wow! Wenji has been upgraded!" Mengqi jumped up and cheered, "I can fight more bad guys in the future!"

    After a moment, Cai Wenji slowly opened her eyes, her face still pale.

    "Junior Sister Cai, have you made a breakthrough?!"

    Wang Lei felt the sudden change of spiritual energy fluctuations on her body, and was surprised and happy, then frowned again, "But you don't seem to be in a good condition..."

    "It's okay, it's just that the merit is slightly overdrawn during the breakthrough, so just take a short rest."

    Cai Wenji stood up and moved her hands and feet, "It's not suitable to stay here for a long time. Let's rush to Qingxi Village as soon as possible to avoid a long night and many dreams."

    Seeing her persistence, Wang Lei said no more, but walked more vigilantly on the outside, keeping her firmly behind him.

    Meng Qi nestled back on Cai Wenji's shoulder and whispered: "Wenji, Wenji, if you are tired, just tell me, I still have a lot of fragrant Meng Yuan!"

    "Okay, thank you, Xiaotuanzi."

    Then the two men and the beast continued to move forward, and the mountain road gradually became narrower.

    After walking about two miles further, Wang Lei suddenly stopped, frowned, raised his hand to hold his sword and said in a deep voice:
title_en: Chapter 016 Breaking through the second level of condensation rhythm, poisonous ghosts appear in the miasma forest
